new_title: Colour Bleeding Test for Dark Plain T-Shirts Before Bulk Printing
meta_description: How to check colour bleeding on navy, royal blue, maroon and black plain t-shirts before you print a bulk order — the wet-rub and hot-water tests, what fastness grade 3 vs 4 vs 5 means, and reactive vs pigment dye.
topic: Colour bleeding on dark plain t-shirts before printing, and how a buyer tests for it himself in five minutes. Cover what colour fastness means, why dark shades (navy, royal blue, maroon, black) bleed more than pastels, the wet-rub test and the hot-water dip test on a sample, what fastness grade 3 vs 4 vs 5 means in practice, and how reactive dye differs from pigment dye for bleeding.
